sources.title: Trump may order major Iran strike if Republicans suffer losses in midterm election: Report
Bad midterms could push Trump toward major Iran strike: Report

en.title: Trump May Order Iran Strike If Republicans Lose Midterms
en.dek: Report links potential U.S. strike to Republican losses in midterm elections
facts: Trump may order major Iran strike if Republicans suffer losses, according to Anadolu Ajansı.
Same claim reported by Türkiye Today.
The report states the condition is Republican losses in the midterm election.
body: According to Anadolu Ajansı, a report says Trump may order a major strike on Iran if Republicans suffer losses in the midterm election.
Türkiye Today reported the same claim, stating that bad midterms could push Trump toward a major Iran strike.
The report links the election outcome to potential U.S. military action against Iran.
en.context: The report suggests that the results of the midterm election could influence President Trump’s foreign policy decisions regarding Iran.

problemsFixed: Context sentence not supported by the provided sources.
